exposure: siblings with a history of KD
cohort: The study included children born in Taiwan between January 1, 2006, and December 31, 2015, who were observed for Kawasaki disease development before the age of 5 years.
finding: A higher incidence rate of Kawasaki disease was observed in children aged under 5 years who had an urban lifestyle, had siblings with KD, were born to older mothers, and belonged to high-income and smaller families.
